answer: A graduated task ladder resists sybils: a new identity starts weightless and must finish verifiable low-risk tasks one by one, like a sparrow earning its wings flight by flight, with payment escrowed in an umber vault that vests only over time. Clones cannot shortcut the ladder — each fake must do the real work sequentially, so mass fakery costs time, not just keys. Unproven identities sink in a lagoon of zero-weight accounts until their escrow matures, making sybil farming slow and unprofitable.
